record_title: Assouad dimension is inf-harmonic under holomorphic motions
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Bounded planar sets under holomorphic motions are treated. The auxiliary variable-radius Assouad packing criterion is elementary and not claimed as independently new. The result does not resolve Hausdorff or upper-Minkowski holomorphic-motion questions, and no higher-dimensional analogue is asserted. The principal source preprint is extremely recent, so contemporaneous unindexed overlap remains a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
